h1: AI agents and automations for finance teams
answer: Finance teams hand off the chasing and the copying first: reminders drafted for late invoices, every Stripe payment logged as a row, and a Monday note on last week’s revenue.
In 50agents each is one sentence to Captain, built on Stripe, QuickBooks, Xero, Gmail and Google Sheets; nothing that reaches a client or moves money happens without your approval.

faqs.q: Is it safe to connect Stripe?
faqs.a: Connect only what each job needs. Automations that read Stripe events and add rows change nothing in Stripe; anything that would spend or refund money asks first.

faqs.q: Can it read invoices from PDFs?
faqs.a: An AI step can read the text of an email and its attachment details to pull out the supplier, amount and due date. Check the first runs against the documents.

faqs.q: Does it replace my accounting software?
faqs.a: No. It does the chasing, copying and summarising around it. Your books stay in QuickBooks, Xero or Zoho Books.

faqs.q: What does it not do yet?
faqs.a: It does not sync with QuickBooks or Xero as a ledger; it reads their events and actions, and the invoices desk keeps its own copy. It never pays, refunds or transfers on its own; anything that moves money asks you. Reminders go by email, not SMS or WhatsApp.
